description: Source code defining several EventSource classes for diagnostic and logging purposes within the Orleans runtime. It includes classes for callback data, outside runtime client, dispatcher, inside runtime client, and incoming message agent events.

classes.name: OrleansCallBackDataEvent
classes.description: Event source for callback data related events such as timeout, target silo failure, callback completion, and cancellation events.

classes.name: OrleansOutsideRuntimeClientEvent
classes.description: Event source for events occurring outside the runtime client, including sending/receiving requests and responses.

classes.name: OrleansDispatcherEvent
classes.description: Event source for message reception events within the dispatcher.

classes.name: OrleansInsideRuntimeClientEvent
classes.description: Event source for events within the inside runtime client, such as sending and receiving messages.

classes.name: OrleansIncomingMessageAgentEvent
classes.description: Event source for reception of incoming messages by the agent.

methods.name: OnTimeout
methods.description: Logs a timeout event related to callback data.

methods.name: OnTargetSiloFail
methods.description: Logs a target silo failure event.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Logs sending request event in external runtime.

methods.name: ReceiveResponse
methods.description: Logs receiving response event in external runtime.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Logs sending response event in external runtime.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Logs message reception event within dispatcher or message agent.
